leaves.name: linYangEx29
leaves.doc: Lin-Yang 2020, Example 29 (discriminant 6), existential form: there is a Hauptmodul j6 of Gamma*\H (continuous, fibres the Gamma*-orbits, surjective, j6 = 0, infinity, -16/27 at the CM points of discriminants -4, -3, -24) with s3^2 = j6 s2^3, s5 = s2 s3, s6 = (j6 + 1) s2^3 along Omega(tau) wherever j6 is finite (s2 = psi4, s3 = psi6, s5 = 2^12 3^5 chi10, s6 = 2^12 3^6 chi12). Replaces theta-fold's linYangEx29All, which is false (it quantifies over every continuous j6 with these clauses, and conj o j6 is one of them). Numerically consistent with j6 = QMHauptmodul's j_theta to 1e-39 at three points (leaf-audit linyang_check.py).
leaves.flag: pending review: Lin-Yang's display of Example 29 not re-read (arXiv:1807.00466v1 pp. 20-21; Math. Z. 295 (2020) 775-819); existence of the Hauptmodul is part of the leaf (genus 0, implicit in Lin-Yang); locators UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Y.-H. Lin, Y. Yang, Quaternionic loci in Siegel's modular threefold, Math. Z. 295 (2020), 775-819; arXiv:1807.00466v1 Example 29 (locator UNVERIFIED)
